airspace.zh: 馬來西亞民航規則（2016年民航條例）：飛行高度超過400英尺須事先核准，不得進入機場交通區；在住宅、商業、工業與休閒區150公尺內、超過一千人的群眾上空，或離船隻、車輛、建築物與人50公尺內飛行，都要取得授權；必須保持目視。沙巴公園局規定：未經許可在公園保護區飛行無人機違反1984年公園法令（2024年修訂），休閒飛行一律禁止，許可只考慮研究、執法與經核准的拍攝。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: Malaysia (Civil Aviation Regulations 2016): flying above 400 ft needs approval and aerodrome traffic zones are off limits; flights within 150 m of residential, commercial, industrial or recreational areas, over gatherings of more than 1,000 people, or within 50 m of vessels, vehicles, structures or people need authorisation; keep direct visual contact. Sabah Parks: flying a drone in a park without a permit breaks the Parks Enactment 1984 (amended 2024); recreational flights are prohibited, and permits are considered only for research, enforcement and authorised filming. Check the current rules before any real flight.

tagline.zh-Hant: 1851年的休・羅、1888年的首次登頂、1964年的公園、戰爭紀念園，到2015年的地震
tagline.en: Hugh Low in 1851, the first to the top in 1888, a park in 1964, a war memorial and the 2015 earthquake

zh: 這裡是婆羅洲北部、馬來西亞沙巴的京那巴魯山，
海拔四千零九十五公尺，是馬來西亞和海上東南亞的最高峰。
en: This is Mount Kinabalu in Sabah, Malaysia, in northern Borneo:
at 4,095 metres the highest peak in Malaysia and Maritime Southeast Asia.

zh: 1997年用衛星重新測量，
比原本公布的四千一百零一公尺，矮了六公尺。
en: A satellite re-survey in 1997
found it 6 metres lower than the published 4,101 metres.

zh: 「京那巴魯」可能來自「阿基・納巴魯」，
意思是「納巴魯祖父」，守護這座山的靈。
en: Kinabalu probably comes from Aki Nabalu, "Grandfather Nabalu",
the mountain's guardian spirit.

zh: 卡達山杜順族的利灣人，叫它「偉大之名」，
每年都有朝山的儀式。
en: The Liwan Kadazandusun call it Gayo Ngaran, "The Great Name",
and make a pilgrimage to it every year.

zh: 1851年3月，英國人休・羅，
跟著吉奧村的杜順族嚮導拉邁英，爬上了山頂高原。
en: In March 1851 Hugh Low reached the summit plateau
with the Dusun guide Lemaing of Kampung Kiau.

zh: 他沒有登上最高點，
但最高峰，後來還是以他命名為「羅氏峰」。
en: He did not reach the highest point,
but the highest peak was later named Low's Peak after him.

zh: 1888年，動物學家約翰・懷海德，
第一個登上了最高點。
en: In 1888 the zoologist John Whitehead
became the first to reach the highest point.

zh: 1910年2月，植物學家莉蓮・吉布斯，
成為第一位登頂的女性，也是第一位登頂的植物學家。
en: In February 1910 Lilian Gibbs became the first woman
and the first botanist to reach the summit.

zh: 1961和1964年，英國皇家學會的考察隊來到這裡；
1964年，京那巴魯公園成立，是馬來西亞最早的國家公園之一。
en: Royal Society expeditions came in 1961 and 1964;
in 1964 Kinabalu Park was founded, one of Malaysia's first national parks.

zh: 山腳下的昆達山戰爭紀念園，建於1962年，
紀念從山打根到拉瑙的三次死亡行軍。
en: The Kundasang War Memorial below the mountain was opened in 1962
to remember the three death marches from Sandakan to Ranau.

zh: 兩千四百二十八名澳洲和英國戰俘死在戰俘營與行軍途中；
大約兩千五百名戰俘裡，只有六名澳洲人活了下來。
en: It names 2,428 Australian and British prisoners who died in the camp and on the marches;
of about 2,500 prisoners, only six Australians survived.

zh: 西邊的首府原名「傑瑟頓」，1899年建立；
1967年12月22日，以這座山改名為「哥打京那巴魯」。
en: The capital to the west, founded as Jesselton in 1899,
was renamed Kota Kinabalu after the mountain on 22 December 1967.

zh: 2000年12月，京那巴魯公園列入世界遺產，
是馬來西亞的第一個世界遺產。
en: In December 2000 Kinabalu Park became World Heritage,
Malaysia's first World Heritage Site.

zh: 2015年6月5日早上七點十五分，一場地震引發山崩，
十八名登山客和嚮導罹難，「驢耳峰」嚴重受損。
en: At 7:15 am on 5 June 2015 an earthquake and the landslides it set off
killed 18 hikers and guides and badly damaged Donkey Ear's Peak.

zh: 對許多山下的人來說，
這是一座有守護靈的聖山。
en: To many people below,
this is a sacred mountain with a guardian spirit.

title.zh-Hant: 登山者、挑夫與高原小鎮
title.en: Climbers, Porters and a Highland Town

tagline.zh-Hant: 必須有嚮導的登山路、背重物的挑夫、拉班拉打山屋，與高原小鎮的蔬菜市集
tagline.en: A guided trail, porters carrying 35 kg, the Laban Rata hut, a highland town and its vegetable market

zh: 爬京那巴魯山，不需要登山裝備，
但一定要有合格的嚮導陪同。
en: Climbing Kinabalu needs no mountaineering gear,
but an accredited guide is mandatory.

zh: 步道從海拔一千八百六十六公尺的廷波洪門出發，
離公園總部五點五公里。
en: The trail starts at Timpohon Gate, at 1,866 metres,
5.5 km from park headquarters.

zh: 多數人走三到六小時，到海拔3,270公尺的拉班拉打山屋過夜；
挑夫背著補給上山，有時超過三十五公斤。
en: Most climbers take 3 to 6 hours to reach the Laban Rata resthouse at 3,270 metres;
porters carry the supplies, sometimes over 35 kg.

zh: 最後兩公里，走在光禿的花崗岩上，
要花兩到四個小時。
en: The final 2 km cross bare granite
and take 2 to 4 hours.

zh: 只有住在山屋的人，才能拿到登頂許可；
2025年的評估說，每天的上限是一百八十八人。
en: Summit permits go only to climbers staying in the mountain huts;
the 2025 assessment gives a cap of 188 climbers a day.

zh: 1987年起，這裡舉辦京那巴魯山登山賽跑，
1988年成為國際賽事。
en: The Mount Kinabalu Climbathon has been run since 1987
and became international in 1988.

zh: 2010年，公園有六十一萬多名訪客，
其中四萬七千六百一十三人是登山客。
en: In 2010 the park had 611,624 visitors,
of whom 47,613 were climbers.

zh: 2022年有五十二萬九千多人，2023年是三十二萬四千多人；
2016年前後，山上開了兩條岩壁攀登路線。
en: Visitors numbered 529,963 in 2022 and 324,757 in 2023;
two via ferrata routes were opened on the mountain around 2016.

zh: 公園總部海拔一千五百六十三公尺，離亞庇約九十公里；
公園由沙巴公園局管理。
en: Park headquarters stands at 1,563 metres, about 90 km from Kota Kinabalu;
the park is run by Sabah Parks.

zh: 昆達山海拔一千九百公尺，
被稱為馬來西亞最高的聚落，2023年約有一萬人。
en: Kundasang, at 1,900 metres, is called the highest settlement in Malaysia;
about 10,000 people lived there in 2023.

zh: 它以蔬菜市集聞名，木頭攤位沿著大路排開；
買家從沙巴、砂拉越和汶萊來批貨。
en: It is known for its vegetable market of wooden stalls along the main road,
with bulk buyers from Sabah, Sarawak and Brunei.

zh: 紀念園有四座花園，代表死者的家鄉；
英國玫瑰園的黑色大理石上，刻著六百四十一個名字。
en: The memorial has four gardens for the homelands of the dead;
the English Rose Garden lists 641 British servicemen on black marble.

zh: 婆羅洲花園，紀念幫助過戰俘的沙巴原住民，
也種著稀有的羅斯柴爾德拖鞋蘭。
en: The Borneo Garden honours the people of Sabah who helped the prisoners,
and grows rare orchids such as Rothschild's slipper orchid.

zh: 1945年的轟炸後，傑瑟頓只剩三棟建築；
2020年，亞庇市區有五十萬零四百二十一人。
en: After the bombing of 1945 only three buildings were left standing in Jesselton;
in 2020 the city had 500,421 people.

zh: 嚮導、挑夫與山下的居民，
讓每一位登山客，都能走到這座山的頂端。
en: Guides, porters and the people who live below the mountain
help every climber on the way to its summit.

title.en: A Kingdom of Plants on One Mountain

tagline.zh-Hant: 五千到六千種植物、上千種蘭花、最大的豬籠草、九十四公分的大王花，與三百二十六種鳥
tagline.en: 5,000 to 6,000 plants, a thousand orchids, the largest pitcher plant, a 94 cm Rafflesia and 326 birds

zh: 京那巴魯公園裡，有五千到六千種維管束植物，
至少是婆羅洲植物種類的一半。
en: Kinabalu Park holds 5,000 to 6,000 species of vascular plants,
at least half of all Borneo's plant species.

zh: 蘭花大約有一千種，
蕨類超過六百種，其中五十種只長在這裡。
en: There are about 1,000 orchid species,
and over 600 ferns, fifty of them found nowhere else.

zh: 山上有十三種豬籠草，五種只長在這裡；
馬來王豬籠草的捕蟲籠，是世界上最大的。
en: Thirteen species of Nepenthes grow on the mountain, five found only here;
Nepenthes rajah has the largest pitchers in the world.

zh: 基思大王花的花朵，
直徑可達九十四公分。
en: The flowers of Rafflesia keithii
can reach 94 cm across.

zh: 這裡有七十八種榕樹，十四種是特有種；
杜鵑花有二十四種，五種只長在這裡。
en: There are 78 species of fig, 14 of them endemic,
and 24 rhododendrons, five found only here.

zh: 海拔一千五百公尺以下是低地森林，
一千四百到兩千九百公尺，是山地雨林。
en: Lowland forest grows up to about 1,500 metres,
and montane rain forest from about 1,400 to 2,900 metres.

zh: 兩千六百到三千二百公尺是亞高山灌叢；
三千五百公尺以上，樹木就長不起來了。
en: Sub-alpine scrub grows from 2,600 to 3,200 metres;
above 3,500 metres it is too harsh for trees.

zh: 公園裡記錄到三百二十六種鳥，
其中二十四種主要只住在這座山上。
en: Some 326 bird species have been recorded in the park,
and 24 live mainly on the mountain.

zh: 京那巴魯蛇鵰，
是極度瀕危的猛禽。
en: The Kinabalu serpent eagle
is critically endangered.

zh: 哺乳動物大約有一百種，
婆羅洲紅毛猩猩，估計有二十五到一百二十隻。
en: There are about a hundred mammal species,
including an estimated 25 to 120 Bornean orangutans.

zh: 山頂一帶至少有二十六種特有的陸蝸牛；
公園裡還住著京那巴魯巨蚯蚓。
en: At least 26 endemic land snails live in the summit zone,
and the park is home to the Kinabalu giant earthworm.

zh: 乾旱與山火，是氣候變遷帶來的最大威脅；
傳統的耕作，侵入了保護區的百分之五到十五。
en: Drought and fire are the main threats from climate change;
traditional cropping has encroached on 5 to 15% of the site.

zh: 外來的假蒲公英（貓兒菊）已經到處都是，
被列為高度威脅。
en: A dandelion-like weed, Hypochaeris radicata, is widespread
and rated a high threat.

zh: 研究發現，主要道路附近的車流噪音，
影響了鳥類的族群。
en: A study linked traffic noise near the main access roads
to effects on bird populations.

zh: 從低地雨林到山頂的岩石，
一座山，就裝下了半個婆羅洲的植物。
en: From lowland rainforest to the rocks of the summit,
one mountain holds half of Borneo's plants.

tagline.zh-Hant: 一千萬年前冷卻的花崗岩、每年五毫米的抬升、冰河、羅氏峽谷與山頂的雪
tagline.en: Granodiorite cooled 10 million years ago, 5 mm of uplift a year, glaciers, an 1,800 m gully and summit snow

zh: 京那巴魯山的突出度，也是四千零九十五公尺，
在全世界排第二十。
en: Kinabalu's prominence is also 4,095 metres,
20th in the world.

zh: 它是地球上第三高的島嶼山峰，
離它最近的更高山峰，在兩千五百一十三公里外。
en: It is the third-highest island peak on Earth,
and the nearest higher peak is 2,513 km away.

zh: 山的核心，是一塊花崗閃長岩的深成岩體，
侵入始新世到中新世的地層裡。
en: Its core is a granodiorite pluton
that pushed into Eocene to Miocene strata.

zh: 這些花崗岩大約在一千萬年前冷卻變硬，
直到今天，山還以每年大約五毫米的速度長高。
en: The granite cooled and hardened about 10 million years ago,
and the mountain is still rising about 5 mm a year.

zh: 大約十萬年前的更新世，
冰河曾經覆蓋這座山。
en: About 100,000 years ago, in the Pleistocene,
glaciers covered the mountain.

zh: 北側的羅氏峽谷，深一千八百公尺；
1998年，才有一支二十七人的隊伍，第一次完整下到谷底。
en: Low's Gully on the north side is 1,800 metres deep;
in 1998 a 27-strong team made the first complete descent.

zh: 2022年10月，京那巴魯山的新近紀花崗岩，
列入國際地質科學聯合會的地質遺產名單。
en: In October 2022 Mount Kinabalu's Neogene granite
was listed by the IUGS as a geological heritage site.

zh: 山頂在十二月到一月，氣溫是零下四度到八度，
六月到九月是三度到十二度。
en: Summit temperatures range from −4 to 8 °C in December and January,
and from 3 to 12 °C from June to September.

zh: 海拔三千七百公尺以上，地面經常結霜。
en: Snow was recorded at the summit in 1975, 1993 and 2022;
above 3,700 metres there is persistent ground frost.

zh: 公園總部一年的雨量，大約兩千七百毫米；
總部在海拔一千五百六十三公尺。
en: Park headquarters receives about 2,700 mm of rain a year;
it stands at 1,563 metres.

zh: 公園面積七百五十四平方公里，
從低地龍腦香林到山頂，跨越四個氣候帶。
en: The park covers 754 square kilometres
and spans four climate zones, from lowland dipterocarp forest to the summit.

zh: 從海邊的亞庇看過去，
京那巴魯山在東北東方大約五十公里處。
en: From Kota Kinabalu on the coast,
the mountain lies about 50 km to the east-northeast.

zh: 2015年的地震之後，登頂步道改了路線；
梅西勞步道，從那時起一直關閉。
en: After the 2015 earthquake the summit trail was re-routed,
and the Mesilau trail has been closed ever since.

zh: 冷卻的岩漿、冰河與地震，
一起雕出了這座還在長高的山。
en: Cooled magma, glaciers and earthquakes
have shaped a mountain that is still growing.
